confidence_notes: Citywide meal, coffee, and beer benchmarks support those anchors; cocktail prices vary widely. Wine is estimated at about 2.25 times draft beer. The hostel private-room average’s per-person basis is unclear, so it was doubled for two people; hotel estimates are holistic and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was needed for food and drink because Mexico City benchmarks were available. Hotel anchors are standalone holistic estimates for a large, high-demand capital.
